statement: ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → (Set.range fun φ => (r * Real.cos φ, r * Real.sin φ)) = {p | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r ^ 2}
script:
# name: set-range-wrap-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Maps.range_wrap
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r), Set.range (fun φ => (r * Real.cos φ, r * Real.sin φ)) = {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r ^ 2} := by
  intro r hr
  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq φ]
  · intro h
    set z : ℂ := ⟨x, y⟩
    have hz : ‖z‖ = r := by
      rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_mk, ← Real.sqrt_sq hr]
      congr 1; nlinarith
    refine ⟨Complex.arg z, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hz, Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg]
    · rw [← hz, Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg]
exact @key (1) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['0', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r), Set.range (fun φ => (r * Real.cos φ, r * Real.sin φ)) = {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r ^ 2} := by
  intro r hr
  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq φ]
  · intro h
    set z : ℂ := ⟨x, y⟩
    have hz : ‖z‖ = r := by
      rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_mk, ← Real.sqrt_sq hr]
      congr 1; nlinarith
    refine ⟨Complex.arg z, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hz, Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg]
    · rw [← hz, Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg]
exact @key (0) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['3', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r), Set.range (fun φ => (r * Real.cos φ, r * Real.sin φ)) = {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r ^ 2} := by
  intro r hr
  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq φ]
  · intro h
    set z : ℂ := ⟨x, y⟩
    have hz : ‖z‖ = r := by
      rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_mk, ← Real.sqrt_sq hr]
      congr 1; nlinarith
    refine ⟨Complex.arg z, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hz, Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg]
    · rw [← hz, Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg]
exact @key (3) ((by norm_num))'),
]
